validation.note: Single mesh, single baked diffuse texture with an embossed dollar-sign face (656 triangles per poly.pizza). Bounding box near-cubic/near-origin, no corruption. Coin only has one distinct textured face baked (a gold disc with a raised '$' -- the reverse/edge is plain gold, no second face design), so it reads as a coin prop rather than a true two-distinguishable-sides heads/tails manipulative.

reviewNote: Thumbnail-inspected before downloading (see validation note on single-face texture) but not yet opened in-engine post-download or screenshotted from the actual .glb. Do not treat as visually approved.
mappedComponent: math/data-and-statistics/probability -- coin-flip is a standard probability manipulative alongside dice. Single-face-texture limitation noted above should be considered before wiring this into a coin-flip interaction; a two-distinguishable-face coin (heads/tails) may need a custom material swap or a different source in a future wave.
notes: A second 'Coin' result from the same account (id 0QjRoZvnOKT) was evaluated and rejected -- its thumbnail shows an octagonal flat gold pedestal/base shape, not a round coin, despite the 'Coin' title (see docs/assets/math-wave2.md).
